purpose: Operational ATS overlay for employer-first expansion without duplicating the large canonical ATS mapping files.

policy.merge: Append only. An overlay company must not already exist in the canonical ats_mapping_jw*.json for the same batch.
policy.coverage_alias: Do not create a second collector when the same official ATS inventory is already covered under the parent/group collector.
policy.verification: FULL only when a structured official inventory has a supported enumerator; PARTIAL for dynamic/custom official career sites where exhaustive enumeration is not yet certified.

coverage_aliases.reason: Telespazio vacancies are published through the Leonardo Workday career inventory; a separate Telespazio collector would duplicate and potentially relabel Leonardo-group jobs.

verification.pagination: Workday CXS limit/offset with total reconciliation

job_watch_method.primary: Enumerate the official Fiserv Workday EXT inventory to exhaustion and retain target-geography roles for semantic review.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use the official Fiserv careers site only to rediscover the canonical Workday board if the tenant/site changes.

limitations: Some business roles are payments-domain specific; role fit must be decided from the full JD, not from title alone.

verification.pagination: Workday CXS limit/offset with total reconciliation

job_watch_method.primary: Enumerate the official Worldpay Workday inventory to exhaustion and retain target-geography roles.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use Worldpay's official careers site to rediscover the Workday site if routing changes.

limitations: Product/implementation roles can be vertical or technical; full-JD semantic screening remains required.

verification.pagination: SuccessFactors Career Site Builder pagination/count reconciliation when exposed

job_watch_method.primary: Enumerate the official Telepass SuccessFactors career site and reconcile displayed totals/pagination.
job_watch_method.fallback: If the board cannot be exhaustively enumerated, retain the official-source attempt as PARTIAL rather than substituting third-party boards.

limitations: The exact SuccessFactors backend endpoint is intentionally not guessed; verification relies on the public official Career Site Builder inventory.

job_watch_method.primary: Enumerate the official Docebo Lever board/API to exhaustion and retain target-geography roles.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use the official Docebo careers page to rediscover the Lever tenant.

limitations: Brianza roles without Milan/Milano in the official location string remain outside the current Milan/Rome/London geographic matcher.

job_watch_method.primary: Enumerate Experian's official SmartRecruiters company inventory and retain target-geography roles.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use the public Experian SmartRecruiters career board to rediscover the company identifier.

limitations: Commercial/sales-heavy roles still require semantic filtering; employer inclusion is driven by Product & Proposition and adjacent strategy families.

verification.pagination: Dynamic official Pinpoint-powered board; exhaustive structured endpoint not yet mapped

job_watch_method.primary: Probe the official DAZN all-jobs inventory and capture stable official role links exposed by the page.
job_watch_method.fallback: Keep PARTIAL coverage and remediate the Pinpoint endpoint separately; do not replace official coverage with a third-party inventory.

limitations: Collector has no dedicated Pinpoint adapter yet, so this source initially uses the official-source probe.

verification.pagination: Dynamic official careers inventory; structured exhaustive endpoint not yet mapped

job_watch_method.primary: Probe Spotify's official jobs page and collect target-geography official job links exposed by the live inventory.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use official Life at Spotify location/job pages only; third-party postings are discovery evidence, not inventory truth.

limitations: The current implementation cannot certify exhaustive enumeration of the custom Spotify jobs frontend.

job_watch_method.primary: Enumerate the official Contentsquare Lever inventory to exhaustion and retain target-geography roles.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use Contentsquare's official careers site to rediscover the Lever tenant.

verification.pagination: Oracle Candidate Experience paged search with location facets

job_watch_method.primary: Enumerate the official INWIT Oracle Candidate Experience site and retain Milan/Rome target roles.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use INWIT's official careers page to rediscover the Oracle Candidate Experience site if its host changes.

limitations: The Oracle candidate site is on an Oracle Cloud host; keep the first-party INWIT careers page as the canonical rediscovery path.

verification.pagination: Official careers page; exhaustive structured inventory endpoint not yet mapped

job_watch_method.primary: Probe NHOA Energy's official careers page and capture stable official vacancy links when exposed.
job_watch_method.fallback: Retain PARTIAL official-source coverage until the underlying ATS/feed is mapped.

limitations: No exhaustive structured ATS/feed has yet been verified from the public careers frontend.

job_watch_method.primary: Probe Cellnex's official job-opportunities page and retain target-geography official links.
job_watch_method.fallback: Retain PARTIAL coverage until the underlying structured inventory can be verified.

limitations: The public page does not yet provide a mapped exhaustible backend to the current collector.

limitations: SuccessFactors is inferred from the public careers URL structure; the exact backend/feed has not been independently certified.
